claims: NASA's Artemis II mission successfully launched on April 1, 2026.
Liftoff of NASA's Artemis II mission occurred at 6:35 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission launched from Kennedy Space Center's Pad 39B in Florida.
The launch window for NASA's Artemis II mission opened at 6:24 p.m. EDT.
NASA's Artemis II mission is the first crewed flight to the Moon since 1972.
NASA's Artemis II mission carries four astronauts.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The location of the Artemis II launch is Pad 39B, Kennedy Space Center, Florida.
The liftoff time for Artemis II is 6:35 p.m. EDT.
The mission duration of Artemis II is approximately 10 days.
The crew of Artemis II is Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Artemis II includes a 10-day trip around the far side of the moon before returning to Earth.
